items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: a fellow came to the house from Machito's band, I didn't know him

ctx.x: Sure. Tried them all. And I almost had a whole drawer full of mouthpieces. And I started getting rid of them. You know, what do I want with all these mouthpieces. I started to get rid of them, and I had about seven or eight of them left, seven or eight left over. And a fellow came to the house from Machito's band, I didn't know him, and he told me that one of the fellows in the band sent him to me, said that I had... He named the type of mouthpiece he wanted, and asked me did I have one. So I told him, yes, I had…
